headline: The local backend now explains failures without leaking stack traces or leaving the UI guessing.
copy: Reliability starts with predictable envelopes, validation, and traceability.

postures.title: Request ID
postures.copy: Every response includes a stable request identifier and response header.

postures.title: Contract version
postures.copy: Clients can verify the source packet envelope version.

postures.title: Invalid JSON
postures.copy: Malformed request bodies return a typed non-retryable error.

postures.title: Empty question
postures.copy: A missing question is named clearly before retrieval begins.

flow.title: Receive
flow.copy: Assign or accept a safe request ID.

flow.title: Validate
flow.copy: Check origin, method, body size, JSON, and question.

flow.title: Resolve
flow.copy: Return a source packet or a visible no-source packet.

flow.title: Explain
flow.copy: Use one typed envelope for success and failure.

decisions.label: Schema
decisions.reason: A stable envelope lets the browser adapter validate responses.

decisions.label: Payload limit
decisions.reason: The local query endpoint should remain small and predictable.

decisions.label: Errors
decisions.reason: Clients should distinguish invalid input, unavailable server, and no-source.

decisions.label: CORS
decisions.reason: The spike remains a private local service.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed translation or corpus delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness does not authorize public launch.
